purpose: Pure numeric Ovid database-update date rows are discarded in v21; when external End_date is supplied it remains the retrieval-date boundary and dependent AND references are simplified.
authority: Normative Cochrane Ovid MEDLINE-to-PubMed Conversion Rules v21
v21_delta: Update-date omission is now unconditional for qualifying pure numeric .ed./.dt. rows; external End_date changes the audit rationale, not whether the row is removed.
